name: Implement @tribunus/client SDK with transport-agnostic operations
description: Build the public TypeScript SDK wrapping TribunusRuntimeClient. HTTP, WebSocket, RPC transports. Semantic operations: createProject, openSession, enqueueWork, observeLifecycle, subscribeToReceipts, requestCapability, attachArtifact, publishProjection. All operations idempotent with classified error types.
